title.en: Ken Griffin pledges $3 billion. What is Carnegie Mellon building?
title.zh: 肯·格里芬承诺捐赠30亿美元，卡内基梅隆要建什么？

summary.en: CMU announces a $3 billion commitment: $2 billion for a planned Miami campus and $1 billion for Pittsburgh. A gift is not a purchase of the university; the Miami opening remains a plan.
summary.zh: 卡内基梅隆宣布获30亿美元捐赠承诺：20亿用于规划中的迈阿密校区，10亿用于匹兹堡。捐赠不是买下大学，迈阿密开学日期仍是计划。

title.en: Ranveer Singh fronts ₹44,300 AI glasses. What can buyers get today?
title.zh: 兰维尔·辛格代言44300卢比起的AI眼镜，今天买到什么？

summary.en: Meta launches Gen 3 glasses in India with Ranveer Singh as brand ambassador. The separate Audio model is coming soon; Meta says its Muse agent will arrive in the coming months.
summary.zh: Meta携品牌大使兰维尔·辛格在印度推出第三代眼镜。另一款Audio产品尚待上市，Muse智能体则称将在未来数月到来。
